notes.title: 【DevLog】Color Workshop has been strengthened 2023.09.25
notes.notes:
### Game Points Rule Adjustment
+ Each Scissors can get 10 points.
+ Each Clover can get 10 points.
+ Each Treasure Bag can get 150 points.
+ Each Life Potion can get 150 points.
+ Each Hp can get 30 points.
+ Energy Points = sqrt(remaining energy)/2.
+ Adventure Level points, 1/2/3/4 stars each can earn 300/50/150/300 points.
+ Points magnification: According to the difficulty, the points multiplier for levels 1 to 6 is 100%/150%/200%/250%/300%/350%.
+ Optimization: The Victory panel allows you to directly view the points rules.
+ Bug fix: fixed the issue of Clovers, Treasure Bag, and Life Potion not adding points.

### Color Workshop Enhancement
+ Fruit Drop : For every other Fruit Drop on the board get 20 Energy (up to 6 times).
+ Fruit Drop Jar : Reduce from 3 stars to 2 stars while reducing the number by 1
+ Gardener : Unique. When there are no roses, get 2 roses.
+ Valentine's Day Orders : Order: Rose x6, get {80A} Energy. Get +{H} Output for every Rose eliminated.
+ Added Paper Airplane achievement

### Treasure Bay Adjustment
+ Pirate Gold : Unique. When the Treasure Maps and  Chests on the board are eliminated, all Golden Products on the board get +10 output.
+ Golden Bell : Gold bells are considered as Gold Products.

### Opera Adjustment
+ Music Score : Pick: Reset the turns of Piano, G Clef and Gorgeous Dress. Eliminate itself after 2 rounds.
+ Gorgeous Dress : The Vocalist disregards distance, treat all pieces as adjacent.
+ Optimization: Optimize for incorrect values in the opera.
+ Optimization: A description of the effect of the piano that can be stacked.
+ Optimization: Enhanced Vocalist.
+ Bug fix: Incorrect description of G Clef "+60 output", should be "+150 output"

### Other Adjustment
+ Hell Mage : Pick: Transform pieces below 3 stars on the board into Hellfire, get +60 output for each transformation.

#### New Talent
+ Fateful Coin : Permanently increases the chance of winning Fateful Coin by 10%

#### Game Optimization
+ Optimization : Holding down the energy ball during combat will display the total energy obtained in the previous round.
+ Optimization : Poisoned BUFF in the game can be clicked to receive relevant prompts.
+ Optimization : The 10 order achievements are broken down into three achievements: 5, 8, and 10.
+ Optimization : The handbook is no longer blocking the display of talents.
+ Optimization : The handbook will display the effects and sources of unlocked talents.
+ Optimization : Challenge Glove - Treasure Steps. When disabling treasure selection, a floating character will pop up in the middle of the screen, indicating that the player's treasure selection has been disabled.

#### Universal Balance
+ Sliced Bread : All pieces of the first Triple get extra 240 Energy. (Originally 120 energy)
+ Potion Booster : All potions will be triggered twice. (Changed from 4 stars to 2 stars, removing the pickup effect)
+ Balance : Reduce the value of 2 stars to 3 stars by 4000
+ Balance : Reduce the value of 3 stars to 4 stars by 16000
+ Optimization : Remove the description of "Initial gain +N output" from all pieces to avoid ambiguity.
+ Optimization: Change the description of all 'initial pieces' to' basic pieces'.
+ Blocks : Increase the final output of Basic Pieces to 200%. (Originally 175%)
+ Giant : Increase the final output of Nearby Giants and Basic Pieces to 150%. (Originally No Skills)

#### Treasure Bay Strengthening
+ Sextant : When located in a corner get 480 extra Energy. (Originally 360)
+ Golden Cup : Get 360 Energy when nearby to Golden Products. (Originally 270)
+ Grape Wine : Get +5 Output for every round. When nearby to Golden Cup get extra 360 energy. (Originally+10 output per round)
+ Yellowed Treasure Map : Get 2 Iron Chests and eliminate itself after 2 rounds. (Originally 3 rounds)
+ Bloody Treasure Map : Get 2 random chests and eliminate itself after 2 rounds. (Originally 3 rounds)
+ Pirate Code : If there is no Treasure Map in the backpack, get 1 Yellowed Treasure Map. (Originally a random treasure map)
+ Pirate Crew : Increase the final output of Golden Products on the board to 200% and eliminate itself. (Redesign)
+ Gold Chest : Eliminated: Get 2 Iron Chests. Golden Products on the board get +60 Output. (Redesign)
+ Pirate Gold : When Treasure Maps and Chests on the board are eliminated, get +10 output. (Redesign)
+ Gold Ore : Will be regarded as Golden Product.

#### Bug Fix
+ Bug Fix : The player's decision to lose is caused by floating point numbers when the monster is killed.
+ Bug Fix : Same Chess Pieces problem caused by lucky potion, add de duplication judgment.

notes.title: 【DevLog】Archive Lost Bug Repair 2023.09.01
notes.notes:
+ We have received feedback from some players. When playing games across devices, you may encounter situations such as lost saves, game progress being reset, and the game's main save being overwritten by a new save.
+ We have currently fixed the issue. In most cases, the game will automatically complete archive synchronization. In a few cases, when there is a conflict in the archive and the program logic cannot be determined, a dialog box will pop up asking the player to choose between local archive or cloud archive.
+ We deeply apologize for the inconvenience caused by this issue. Players who have already lost their archives before this repair can contact us to repair the archives.
+ Thanks for your support.
